facts.text: The Fosse car park, Riverside Road, Richmond DL10 4JR, is ticketless: pay on arrival by cash, RingGo or contactless card. Charges apply 8am to 6pm: 30 minutes £0.80, 1 hour £2.20, 2 hours £3.70, 4 hours £5.10. It has 39 spaces including 2 disabled; disabled badge holders park free for up to 4 hours. The council's page does not mention the bathing site.
The bathing site lies below the Fosse car park and above the series of waterfalls known as Richmond Falls, on the western side of Richmond.

The Falls toilets on Riverside Road, Richmond, are open 8am to 8pm, Monday to Sunday. The fee is £0.20; there is an accessible toilet with Radar key. The council's page does not mention the bathing site.
